title: TE Don Clements v. Blue Ridge Presbytery — Decision on Complaint
disposition_detail: The SJC answered the complaint by reference to its decision in 2017-06 and directed Blue Ridge Presbytery to hear and decide it. The denial in the incorporated decision concerned Presbytery’s request for reference, not the complaint’s merits.
first_summary: The SJC returned Clements’s complaint to Blue Ridge Presbytery for decision, answering it by reference to companion case 2017-06. That decision denied Presbytery’s effort to have the SJC hear the complaint because the record showed none of the circumstances warranting reference under BCO 41. The underlying complaint’s merits remained undecided.
summary: Blue Ridge Presbytery sought to have the SJC decide Clements’s complaint rather than hear it locally. Answering the complaint by reference to companion case 2017-06, the SJC directed Presbytery to hear and decide it because the record did not establish bias, serious division, constitutional questions, or unusually difficult issues warranting reference under BCO 41. The ruling did not decide the complaint’s merits.

sources.supports: Joint identity, request for reference, adopted reasons, direction that Presbytery hear the complaint, disposition of 2017-07 by reference, and unanimous approval.

evidence_notes.identity_and_adoption: Lines 11–13 identify cases 2017-06 and 2017-07 and the parties; lines 27–31 state the complaint’s answer and unanimous SJC approval.
evidence_notes.dispute: Lines 15–16 show that Presbytery requested SJC adjudication of the complaint under BCO 41-3.
evidence_notes.outcomes_and_reasons: Lines 17–25 reject reference for lack of demonstrated bias, serious division, constitutional questions, or difficult issues and direct Presbytery to hear the complaint; line 27 applies that decision to 2017-07.
evidence_notes.qualifications: Line 27 supplies no ruling on the complaint’s substantive merits; the denial at lines 24–25 concerns the companion reference request.
evidence_notes.incorporated_decisions: The complete operative result and reasoning of incorporated case 2017-06 appear at lines 15–25 of the same source.

source_limits: The combined decision does not describe the complaint’s substantive allegations or adjudicate their merits.
